item.title: 'Uncertainty' to remain after Trump tariffs ruling - trade minister
item.description: Trade Minister Todd McClay said New Zealand exports had been holding up well overall in the US market since the original 15 percent tariff was imposed. item.title: NZ man in Australia deported after multiple offences
item.description: The man, who grew up in Hastings but has lived in Australia since he was 15, is being sent back to New Zealand as a "501" deportee. Photo: NZME WARNING: This article includes discussion of family violence offending and may be distressing. A New Zealand citizen who avoided deportation from Australia six years ago is being kicked out after ignoring a warning about his immigration status, and committing crimes.
